claim.claim-text: 2. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 1, wherein the atrial portion (22) includes the prosthetic valve structure (25).
3. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 1, wherein the ventricular portion (24) includes the prosthetic valve structure (25).
4. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 1, wherein ends of the hooks (28) can contact an annulus (6) of the native mitral valve behind the native mitral leaflets (8).
5. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 1, wherein the hooks (28) can extend through native chordae tendineae (10).
6. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 1, wherein the atrial portion (22) comprises an annular structure that seats against the atrial surface of an annulus (6) of the native mitral valve.

7. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 1, wherein the ventricular portion (24) comprises two or more discrete ventricular members that are each coupled to the atrial portion (22) with one or more respective retention members (26).

8. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of any of the preceding claims, wherein at least one of the atrial portion (22) and the ventricular portion (24) includes a ratcheting mechanism and at least one retention member (26) extends through the ratcheting mechanism.
9. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 8, wherein the atrial portion (22) includes one or more ratcheting mechanisms.
10. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 8 or claim 9, wherein the ventricular portion (24) includes one or more ratcheting mechanisms.

11. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of any of claims 8-10, wherein the length of the one or more retention members (26) between the atrial portion (22) and the ventricular portion (24) is capable of being shortened by pulling a free end of the retention member (26) through the ratcheting mechanism or by advancing the ratcheting mechanism along the retention member.

12. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 1, wherein the prosthetic mitral valve (20) can be radially compressed and loaded into a catheter for delivery and then expanded at the native mitral valve.

13. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 12, wherein the atrial portion (22) can expand in the left atrium (2) and the ventricular portion (24) can expand in the left ventricle via (4) resilient self-expansion when released from the catheter.

14. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 1, wherein the hooks (28) comprise a superelastic material that allows the hooks (28) to be straightened during delivery and curl back to an operative position for engaging the native mitral leaflets (8).
15. The prosthetic mitral valve (20) of claim 14, wherein the hooks (28) can curl more than 360 degrees in their operative position.
